record.question: I write a letter to you tentatively _____ the dates of the programme.
record.explanation: Answer D: indicating. “Indicating the dates” means stating or showing the dates tentatively; the other options do not fit the intended sense. Independent check: “Indicating the dates” means stating/showing them in the letter. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/indicate. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
